title: M13, an anthraquinone compound isolated from Morinda officinalis alleviates the progression of the osteoarthritis via the regulation of STAT3.
authors: Zhang, Baolin; Xiao, Ya; Su, Deying; Li, Chuan; Zhang, Shun; Long, Jiahui; Weng, Ricong; Liu, Hengyu; Chen, Yingtong; Liao, Zhiheng; Zhu, Xu; Huang, Junming; Chen, Shuqing; Zhou, Taifeng; Ma, Yuan; Xu, Caixia
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药蒽醌化合物M13通过抑制STAT3信号通路缓解骨关节炎，虽涉及STAT3蛋白与DNA结合的分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合体系，且方法为辅助验证，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoarthritis (OA) is characterized by the progressive deterioration of articular cartilage, leading to joint pain and functional impairment. OA severely impacts quality of life and presents a substantial societal burden. Currently, effective treatment options remain limited. Morinda officinalis (MO), a traditional Chinese herb, is commonly used to treat rheumatoid arthritis and alleviate joint pain. M13, an anthraquinone extracted from MO, has shown significant anti-inflammatory properties, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of OA. However, its role in inhibiting OA progression and the mechanisms involved remain poorly understood. PURPOSE: The objective of this study is to examine the impact of M13 on osteoarthritis and uncover the mechanisms. METHODS: The effects of M13 on OA were assessed using TNF-alpha induced chondrocyte models and mice with destabilization of the medial meniscus (DMM). Celecoxib was used as a positive control. We evaluated the expression of factors related to chondrocyte degeneration and inflammation through qRT-PCR, immunoblotting, and immunofluorescence. Chondrocyte viability was measured using CCK-8 assays, EdU staining, and flow cytometry. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) were performed to evaluate the binding efficacy of target proteins. Additionally, the therapeutic effects of M13 in OA mice were confirmed through in vivo experiments. RESULTS: In primary murine chondrocytes, M13 rescued TNF-alpha-induced matrix degradation and loss of vitality while suppressing ROS generation. Mechanistically, STAT3 was identified as a target protein of M13, through which M13 mitigated OA by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway. Further in vivo experiments demonstrated that M13 reduced the scores of the Osteoarthritis Research Society International (OARSI), alleviating cartilage impairment. M13 enhanced levels of collagen II and aggrecan in cartilage tissue while decreasing the amounts of cartilage-degrading proteins ADAMTS-5 and MMP13. CONCLUSION: This is the first study to validate that M13 mitigates the inflammation and damage in cartilage tissue by blocking the STAT3 signaling pathway. These findings hold promise for enhancing innovative clinical interventions targeting OA.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎（OA）以关节软骨进行性退化为特征，导致关节疼痛和功能障碍。OA严重影响生活质量，并带来巨大的社会负担。目前，有效的治疗选择仍然有限。巴戟天（Morinda officinalis, MO）作为一种传统中草药，常用于治疗类风湿性关节炎并缓解关节疼痛。M13是从MO中提取的一种蒽醌类化合物，已显示出显著的抗炎特性，使其成为治疗OA的有前景的候选药物。然而，其在抑制OA进展中的作用及相关机制仍知之甚少。目的：本研究旨在探讨M13对骨关节炎的影响并揭示其机制。方法：使用肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）诱导的软骨细胞模型和内侧半月板失稳（DMM）小鼠模型评估M13对OA的作用。塞来昔布作为阳性对照。通过qRT-PCR、免疫印迹和免疫荧光评估与软骨细胞退变和炎症相关因子的表达。使用CCK-8实验、EdU染色和流式细胞术测量软骨细胞活力。通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟和等温滴定量热法（ITC）评估靶蛋白的结合效力。此外，通过体内实验确认M13在OA小鼠中的治疗效果。结果：在原代小鼠软骨细胞中，M13挽救了TNF-alpha诱导的基质降解和活力丧失，同时抑制了ROS生成。机制上，STAT3被鉴定为M13的靶蛋白，M13通过抑制STAT3信号通路来缓解OA。进一步的体内实验表明，M13降低了国际骨关节炎研究学会（OARSI）评分，减轻了软骨损伤。M13提高了软骨组织中II型胶原和聚集蛋白聚糖的水平，同时减少了软骨降解蛋白ADAMTS-5和MMP13的含量。结论：这是首次研究验证M13通过阻断STAT3信号通路减轻软骨组织的炎症和损伤。这些发现有望促进针对OA的创新临床干预措施的发展。
